summary: Tested SMS carrier rules end to end, both API and UI, in the dry-run preview. Backend: 13 of 13 pytest cases passed. sms-reach returns 'limited', 15 countries and the right prices. Bob's hosted number shows the P2P note; Alice's long-code number shows the 10DLC note. Another account's number gives 404, and no session gives 401. /sms-reach/check gives: CA ok $0.05 (number); US blocked (mode 'approval'); UK 'brand' blocked with no sender name, then ok with from=BOBCO at $0.08 once it is set; IN blocked ('takes weeks'); BR ok $0.06; '12' gets the country-code message; JP is blocked. The sender-name PUT trims spaces and rejects AB, TOOLONGNAME12, 12345, BAD!NAME and ÄBCD (400 invalid_sender); an empty value clears it to null. Hosted send charges CA 0.05, BR 0.06 and UK 0.08 (sent from=BOBCO). The charge is checked in walletOf and phoneLogs. US sends are refused with the P2P message, no charge and no log. Inbox hosted reply to a US number gives 400 with no charge. Missed-call text back from Alice's number to a US number gives 400 sms_blocked (10DLC), and the reply claim is released; to a CA number it gives 200 preview. UI: Bob's Texting page shows the chip 'Limited texting · can text 4 countries' and the US note. Tapping the chip opens the list of all 15 countries with prices or reasons. The To field gives: CA 'Canada · $0.05 per text' with Send enabled; US amber reason with Send disabled; UK with no name shows the reason and a 'Set it now' link with Send disabled. The link goes to Settings; saving an invalid name shows a toast, and BOBCO saves and is still there after reload. The UK note then reads '$0.08 · Shows as “BOBCO”' and Send is enabled; India is disabled; a Canada send shows the toast 'Sent · $0.05'. The price cell and billing line copy are correct. Inbox: the BR hosted reply shows 'Brazil · $0.06 per text' and '$0.06 from your wallet', and sends. The US reply shows the amber note, and presets and Send are disabled. Alice's missed-call Text back to a US number shows the amber 10DLC note with Send disabled. Alice's number detail page shows number-sms-reach-chip 'Limited texting', the note and the country list. No page errors.

minor.issue: Every +1 number that is not a Canadian area code counts as US. That includes Caribbean and other NANP numbers (+1876 Jamaica, +1787 Puerto Rico, +1809 Dominican Republic). Today they are blocked as 'US mobiles'. Once 10DLC or P2P is on, they would be sent and charged the US $0.05 price.

ui_bugs.issue: The 'Set it now' link (/app/settings#sender-name) did not scroll to the card. useHashScroll looks for id 'settings-sender-name', but the card's id was 'sender-name'. FIXED by changing the id to settings-sender-name; checked: the card is now at y=96.

issues: The count line still says '$0.05 from your wallet' while the send is blocked. The costNote is fixed when meta.hosted is set; consider hiding it when blocked.
The copy repeats itself: '…Set yours in Settings → Text sender name. Set it now'. Drop the 'Settings → …' sentence, since the link is right there.
Opening the reach list in the header pushes the status pills (active / renews / preview) down to the bottom right of the tall header block, which looks unbalanced.

action_items: Optional: treat non-US/CA NANP area codes (Caribbean, PR, territories) as their own or unknown countries in sms-rules countryOf
Optional: hide or adjust the hosted costNote when the destination is blocked; remove the repeated 'Settings → Text sender name' sentence from the brand 'why' text when the 'Set it now' link is shown
critical_code_review_comments: sms-reply.send calls smsRules.check without isHosted. That is correct for long codes, but the US 'why' text depends on the flag, so keep it that way.

facts() caches per phone for 10 minutes, and the P2P switch only happens inside facts(). A number that becomes P2P-eligible opens up only on the next cache miss. That is acceptable, but there is no way to invalidate the cache after a manual change.
The hosted sendText debit, credit-on-failure and log flow is consistent, and a blocked rule returns before any debit.
seed_data_creation: Temporary webNotifications (TEST_SMSRULES) and phoneLogs missed calls were seeded and then removed. Wallets were restored by the pytest fixture after the API tests. The UI sends added small preview charges to Bob's wallet ($0.05 CA, $0.06 BR) and preview phoneLogs. Bob's senderName is set to BOBCO.
